city_served.value: Ridgeland, SC is served — one of the 12 towns claimed on the site, all confirmed by Paul 2026-10-06.
city_served.source: Brand Guide E (all 12 towns confirmed, Paul 2026-10-06); decisions-settled 'business' (12 towns)

local_context.value: Town centre on a low ridge at 62 ft (page; infobox says 16 ft, so inconsistent) — name refers to some of the highest land in Jasper County. 2020 census population about 3,750; 1,151 housing units, 9.6% vacant; median age 36.4. Page has no climate/hurricane/flood text.

neighborhoods.source: not found — tried: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ridgeland,_South_Carolina (names none inside town; nearby places Old House, Switzerland, Tillman, Point South are separate communities)

things_to_do.value: Ridgeland farmers market (weekends, April to December); visit the historic sites Old House Plantation and Old Baptist Church.

top_sites.value: Jasper County Courthouse (Ridgeland is the county seat); Old House Plantation (childhood home of Thomas Heyward Jr., Declaration of Independence signer); Old Baptist Church (former Union forces headquarters).
